name: Ethiopian Macchiato
description: Rich espresso layered with creamy, thick steamed milk, served in a traditional glass.

name: Jebena Buna (Traditional Coffee)
description: Authentic organic coffee slow-brewed in a clay pot (jebena) and infused with a hint of cardamom.

name: Layered Mango & Avocado Juice
description: Stunning fresh layered juice smoothie with local avocado and mango, thick and refreshing.

name: Special Ful
description: Mashed fava beans with olive oil, jalapeños, tomatoes, onions, and crumbled feta cheese. Served hot with fresh warm bread.

name: Chechebsa (Kitta Fit-Fit)
description: Shredded flatbread pan-fried in spiced butter (niter kibbeh) and berbere, drizzled with honey, and served with fresh yogurt.
